title_zh: STEVE：面向计算机使用智能体训练的步骤验证流水线
one_line: GPT-4o labels each agent step from before/after screens; KTO trains a 7B Windows agent on these labels, checked online on WinAgentArena.
one_line_zh: 用GPT-4o依据动作前后截图为每步打二值标签，再用KTO训练7B桌面智能体，在WinAgentArena在线验证

online_eval.quote: achieving leading performance in the challenging live desktop environment WinAgentArena with great efficiency at a reduced cost

held_out_env.quote: Ultimately, we synthesized over 4,000 tasks in the Windows environment, covering various scenarios such as OS settings, file explorer, Windows app, and website browsing.

strong_baselines.quote: Besides, we show the performance of our 7B agent model trained with SFT and KTO.

cost_reported.quote: Our agent model achieves a processing time of 0.4 seconds per frame at a cost of $6 per 1,000 tasks

component_ablation.quote: The results show that SFT performs comparably to the OmniParser baseline with GPT-4o, but KTO consistently improves task success rates across rounds.

validator_check.quote: It is necessary to validate the consistency between a GPT-4o verifier and human judges. We randomly sample a subset of trajectories and manually annotate each step.

evidence_level.quote: achieving leading performance in the challenging live desktop environment WinAgentArena with great efficiency at a reduced cost

S1.quote: the GPT-4o verifier demonstrates a high degree of alignment with human judgments during the early phase of the trajectory steps

S2.quote: the incorrect actions, such as invalid or erroneous clicks, can be easily distinguished from the correct ones by comparing the screens before and after the agent's action

F1.quote: the evaluation of actions becomes more challenging due to dependencies on both the current step and preceding actions within the trajectory

F2.quote: However, as the task progresses into the late phase, the verifier's precision decreases.

F4.quote: we used the GPT-4o verifier to annotate each step in the trajectory, resulting in a large-scale dataset with stepwise annotations

AP4.quote: We found that the general visual capabilities of large powerful VLMs, such as GPT-4o, allow for highly accurate evaluations, which aligned well with human judges.

AP5.quote: We leveraged the synthesized tasks in parallel Windows environments [ 4 ] to enable the agent to execute and log screenshots and actions during task execution.

AP8.quote: We compare the multi-round KTO training with the SFT training on three categories of tasks from the WinAgentArena benchmark: File Explorer, Web Browser, and VsCode

title_zh: WebNav：面向语音控制网页导航的智能体
one_line: Prompted dual-Gemini controller/assistant acts on numbered DOM marks drawn by a browser extension; system description only, no empirical evaluation.
one_line_zh: 双Gemini控制器/助手基于浏览器插件标注的DOM编号元素执行网页操作；仅系统描述，无实验评估

online_eval.quote: While still in a theoretical and developmental stage, the complete implementation of WebNav demonstrates the feasibility and potential of this approach.

code.quote: Finally, we provide a comprehensive, open-source implementation demonstrating the system's effectiveness across diverse web-based tasks.

AP12.quote: This separation of concerns—”what to do” versus ”how to format it”—enhances reliability and minimizes errors.

AP14.quote: When triggered by Alt+Shift+L , its content script ( content.js ) overlays the page, querying the DOM for elements like buttons and links. Each visible element is boxed and assigned a unique number

AP17.quote: The Assistant Module , also a Gemini model, converts the Controller's command into a strict JSON object.

title_zh: 迈向使用计算机的个人智能体
one_line: Position paper proposing computer-use agents with policy-controlled access to a personal knowledge graph; roadmap only, no system or evaluation.
one_line_zh: 立场论文：提出让计算机使用智能体在策略控制下访问个人知识图谱，仅为路线图，无系统与评估

online_eval.quote: We provide a road-map towards realising this vision of CUPAs, discussing what is achievable now with current technology, and what gaps must be addressed via further research and development.

title_zh: 推进移动GUI智能体：面向实际部署的验证器驱动方法
one_line: Replaces action generation with a trained 8B verifier scoring all extracted candidate actions; online AndroidWorld/AndroidLab/MobileAgentBench gains with latency reported.
one_line_zh: 用训练的8B验证器对抽取的全部候选动作打分并执行最高分动作，在三个在线安卓基准上提升成功率并报告延迟

online_eval.quote: V-Droid obtains a substantial task success rate across several public mobile task automation benchmarks: 59.5% on AndroidWorld, 38.3% on AndroidLab, and 49% on MobileAgentBench

held_out_env.quote: During the training data collection process, we rigorously excluded applications utilized in these two benchmarks to ensure unbiased evaluation.

strong_baselines.quote: We craft three baselines to justify the designs in V-Droid , including LLM-as-a-Judge , Selector and Generator .

budget_matched.quote: We directly adopt the SR number reported in the respective baseline papers on the corresponding benchmarks.

cost_reported.quote: Furthermore, V-Droid achieves a remarkably low latency of 4.3s per step, which is 6.1x faster compared with existing mobile agents.

component_ablation.quote: Training Llama-3.1-8B as either a selector or generator improves success rates to 35.8% and 27.4%, respectively. However, these models still underperform compared with V-Droid

validator_check.quote: After training with 27K and 55K data pairs, the AUC improves from 0.55 to approximately 0.8, demonstrating a significant enhancement in the verifier's ability to predict decision correctness.

code.quote: The source code is available at https://github.com/V-Droid-Agent/V-Droid.

evidence_level.quote: During the training data collection process, we rigorously excluded applications utilized in these two benchmarks to ensure unbiased evaluation.

F2.quote: V-Droid is compared with a wide range of mainstream mobile agents, including text-only agents

AP5.quote: Among the three benchmarks, AndroidWorld is designated as the in-the-domain test set, whereas AndroidLab and MobileAgentBench are designated as out-of-domain (OOD) test sets.

AP8.quote: We directly adopt the SR number reported in the respective baseline papers on the corresponding benchmarks.

AP14.quote: A rule-based extractor is applied to detect UI elements, such as button, checkbox, and textbox, that are clickable, long-clickable, scrollable, or editable.

title_zh: GUI-Xplore：一次探索赋能可泛化GUI智能体
one_line: Feeds app exploration videos, distilled into a GUI transition graph, to an LLM agent; offline multiple-choice and step metrics on held-out apps.
one_line_zh: 将应用探索视频提炼为GUI转移图供大模型推理，在未见应用上以离线选择题和步级指标评估

online_eval.quote: To ensure consistency across tasks with diverse output formats, we standardize all tasks as five-way multiple-choice questions.

held_out_env.quote: Specifically, 20% of apps from the manual dataset were allocated to the test set to ensure representation across all six software categories.

strong_baselines.quote: we selected three SOTA GUI agent methods for comparative evaluation, including CogAgent [ 12 ] , SeeClick [ 5 ] and AUTO-UI [ 34 ]

cost_reported.quote: our clustering method effectively reduces token usage while simultaneously improving prediction accuracy

component_ablation.quote: We performed ablation studies to compare our clustering method against a traditional rule-based approach, which utilizes View Hierarchy (VH) and screenshot similarity for clustering.

evidence_level.quote: Following the evaluation metrics of the Mind2web benchmark, we include Element Accuracy (Ele. Acc.), Operation Accuracy (Op. Acc.), and Step Success Rate (StepSR).

S1.quote: GUI-Xplore incorporates pre-recorded exploration videos for each app.

AP7.quote: Following the evaluation metrics of the Mind2web benchmark, we include Element Accuracy (Ele. Acc.), Operation Accuracy (Op. Acc.), and Step Success Rate (StepSR).

AP8.quote: This test set includes 500 operations spanning 20 diverse software apps and is structured consistently with standard automation benchmarks.

AP9.quote: Without automation-specific pre-training, Xplore-Agent effectively integrates general knowledge from LVLMs with app-specific knowledge acquired during the exploration phase.
